fullTextZH: 我要说我的爸爸很胖的第二个故事
fullTextEN: I want to tell the second story about my very fat dad

fullTextZH: 我说在内蒙古有很多很胖的人
fullTextEN: I said there are many very fat people in Inner Mongolia

fullTextZH: 因为我们都很喜欢吃肉
fullTextEN: Because we all really like eating meat
So he is also very fat

fullTextZH: 在内蒙古有很多很胖的人
fullTextEN: There are many very fat people in Inner Mongolia

fullTextZH: 如果我的爸爸离开内蒙古会怎么样
fullTextEN: What if my dad leaves Inner Mongolia?
I go to college in Sichuan
Sichuan is very far from Inner Mongolia

fullTextZH: 在四川很多人都不胖很瘦
fullTextEN: In Sichuan, many people are not fat but very thin
Are there no fat people in Sichuan?

fullTextZH: 但是没有跟我爸爸一样胖的人
fullTextEN: But there are no people as fat as my dad
My dad went to Sichuan to see me
We went out to eat together
So I looked to the left
They were looking at my dad
I want to take a look

fullTextZH: 我在四川没看到过这么胖的人
fullTextEN: I have never seen such a fat person in Sichuan
Have you been to the zoo?

fullTextZH: 像看动物园里的动物一样
fullTextEN: Like looking at animals in the zoo
There are more and more people here
I really want to leave quickly.

fullTextZH: 他觉得所有人都很喜欢他

fullTextEN: My dad went on a trip.
So he doesn't like the heat.
They were not in the city.
My dad took off his clothes.

fullTextZH: 所以很多旅行的人都来看他
fullTextEN: So many travelers came to see him.

fullTextZH: 很多人和他一起拍照片
fullTextEN: Many people took photos with him.

fullTextZH: 你看到了我的爸爸这么胖的人
fullTextEN: You saw my dad, such a fat person
Would you take a photo with him?
The second story of being very fat

fullTextZH: 下一次我还有第三个故事
fullTextEN: Next time I still have a third story
